## Contract and outcomes

DocumentSearch and BlockReorder are typed factories; configure creates per-editor immutable configuration. EditorFacadeOptionsV1 connects the admitted extension/formatting/collaboration/platform/asset contract. The qualified consumer enables search/reorder in collaborative views and leaves them absent from the independent local note.

## Errors and recovery

Invalid options, conflicts, unsupported schema/capabilities or missing host permissions must fail admission before attachment. Do not modify another editor's configuration or infer authority from a loaded shared asset.

## Prerequisites and platform limits

This is the pinned Search/Reorder subset only. Full one-import catalogs, authoring recipes, other factories and managed-loading claims await their exact SDK-1.11/1.12 and EXT-1.20 deliveries. Export presence alone is not runtime qualification.
